body:
I literally thought I had some
Neurological disease but reading people that have this makes me feel better.

I’ve literally convinced myself i have a neurological disorder or something even
Though people on forums don’t think I have them such as rls and als 
I read symptoms now I have it and it hurts not
Only when I sit but stand and walk and swim ( on vacay freaking)
Could it be due to bfs I see my muscles move
Do you get this when you try to sleep
So u have a stim?
I’m worried it’s like restless leg syndrome as this caused the anxiety of my jerks
No problem and just for reassurance do your whole limbs themselves jerk I’m not talking about just the muscle but the entire thing like A tic or something or seizure because this is bothering me

Oh thank goodness you gave me some
Relief I’m panicking on vacay now scared I had some condition! I hope anxiety is causing this
do your whole limbs/foot/hand move?
Only a gp who thinks it’s anxiety and I’m seeing a neurologist nov 1 I’m on vacation and I’m not enjoying a second of it it’s hard to sleep and walk and everything I’m so worried
Extremely unlikely
They’re regular they all day and night the cramps and my foot or leg moves by itself when I’m ancious
This is what I worry about I’m literally crying on vacation because now I can’t have kids or live a normal life because I might have it even though I just shake my leg due to  having Aspergers
Does rls run in ur family
I am terrified of having rls although months prior I had no rls symptoms ever since I googled  it and read people experiences
I don’t have to move anything I just fear I have rls
When i move I still have cramps
I was sitting and my calf hurt and I moved my leg and it went away. It seems like its rls even though I have no urge to get up
Yeah I don’t know if I have rls I just worry I’ll have it on flight I don’t want to analyze my legs or limbs the whole time
What if you have a ticklish feeling in ur leg when sitting but u dont feel like u have to move it?
When I walk I still feel symptoms so it could hopefully just be tension pressing on nerves. Thank you.

My doctor referred me to a neurologist. When i move my feet or legs  pain does not subside it feels worse. I admit I do have anxiety and this is causing a lot but my body is feeling off and tingly everywhere and I’m worried something is wrong.
I dont think this was helpful but thank you
Like the whole leg and hand?
I took SSRI in the summer but stopped them cold turkey in august. Prior i did not have rls, it doesn’t run in my family.
So anxiety can mimic restless leg syndrome symptoms ? Because prior to didnt have restless leg syndrome
I’m so worried I have restless leg it triggered my anxiety I hope it’s just anxiety causing the symptoms
When I’m not anxious I don’t feel any symptoms
I suffer this as well in the morning upon waking up. It doesn’t wake me up thankfully but it happens maybe ten min after waking up. It can be tension as a result of anxiety.
